These values are exposed by structural unfolding of the list-indexed xizi_dllseg; they are not guessed from C state.

The helper partitions head links, prefix cells, selected-node links, suffix cells, and the two boundary fields without duplicating or dropping ownership.
witnesses.pure_plan: The selected address is a nonempty xizi_dllseg element, so its branch supplies linklist_node_pre <> NULL. Head non-null comes from xizi_dll in the first disjunct and PreH1 in the second. No arithmetic automation or extra equality premise is required.
